title: 第5章 豪门千金（5）-《反派BOSS有毒》
content:
第(1/3)页

    时笙此时脸上还挂着泪痕，眼眶微红，咬着唇瓣故作倔强的样子格外的惹人怜惜，“伯母，谢谢您这些年的喜爱，身为女人，您应该明白这个道理，我……”

    这句话可谓是说到南宫夫人心坎里去了。

    南宫政没有许父那么专一，外面的女人也是有好几个，因为南宫政一直拎得清，从不让那些女人怀上孩子，也不让那些女人到她面前闹，所以她也只能睁只眼闭只眼，这就是豪门。

    但是此时看到一个年纪轻轻的小姑娘，还是自己很喜欢的小姑娘，即将步入自己的后尘，南宫夫人心底自然是有些不忍的。

    她动了动唇瓣，最终却是什么都没说出来。

    “丫头可想清楚了？”许父郑重的问了一遍。

    时笙点头，“想清楚了。”

    她抬眼看向南宫景，明明是一脸的沉重悲伤，可南宫景对上她那双眼睛，却只看到平静，即便是她眼角还挂着泪花，她眼底都只有平静，风平浪静。

    南宫景总觉得哪里有些奇怪，仿佛她不应该这样。

    但是一想到能解除婚约，那分奇怪又被他压了下去，冷冷的对上时笙的视线。

    “乘月丫头，这事不是小事，关乎到两家的利益，咱们还是从长计议可好？”南宫政想的是，老爷子若是知道这两人解除婚约，指不定得把他骂成什么样子。他最怕的就是老爷子，所以他也是最不愿时笙和南宫景解除婚约的。

    不管是从两家利益，还是从私人角度，解除婚约都不是一件明智之举。

    要不是那臭小子……偷吃竟然敢在自己家里，实在是年轻气盛，自己还得好好教导一下。

    “南宫先生。”

    楚棠忽然出声，吓得南宫政一个激灵，赶忙回头略带恭敬的看着楚棠。

    楚棠嘴角弯了弯，“人家姑娘说得很明白了，南宫先生就不要耽搁别人的幸福。”

    南宫政余光扫了一眼低垂着头的时笙，她竟然能让楚棠帮忙说话……

    “我知道了。”楚棠这人，一言不合就能让你破产，他可不敢得罪。

    在场的人除了时笙和南宫政，估计没人知道楚棠的真实身份，所以此时南宫政这么一副低三下气的模样，着实让人奇怪这个青年的身份。

    但也没人敢问。

    解除婚约需要召开记者发布会，所以这件事被南宫政暂时推迟到了三天后。

    三天的时间，若是有什么变故，也足够了。

    楚棠临走的时候给了时笙一张名片，黑色打底，银色暗纹绘制，低调奢华，却极显尊贵。

    上面只有楚棠两个字和一串数字，显然是私人号码。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At this time, Shi Sheng's face was still stained with tears, his eyes were slightly red, and he was biting his lip and pretending to be stubborn, which was particularly pitiful. "Aunt, thank you for your love over the years. As a woman, you should understand this truth. I..."

This sentence can be said to have touched Mrs. Nangong’s heart.

Nangong Zheng is not as dedicated as Xu's father, and there are several women outside. Because Nangong Zheng has always been careful and never lets those women get pregnant or make trouble in front of her, so she can only turn a blind eye. This is a wealthy family.

But when she saw a young girl, whom she liked very much, who was about to follow in her footsteps, Mrs. Nangong couldn't bear it in her heart.

She moved her lips, but in the end she said nothing.

"Girl, have you thought clearly?" Xu's father asked solemnly.

Shi Sheng nodded, "I've thought about it clearly."

She raised her eyes to look at Nangong Jing, with a face obviously full of sadness, but when Nangong Jing met her eyes, he saw only peace. Even though there were tears hanging from the corners of her eyes, there was only peace and tranquility in her eyes.

Nangong Jing always felt something was strange, as if she shouldn't be like this.

But when he thought of breaking off the engagement, he suppressed the strangeness again and met Shi Sheng's eyes coldly.

"Girl Chengyue, this matter is not a trivial matter. It concerns the interests of both families. How about we discuss it in the long term?" Nangong Zheng was thinking about how the old man might scold him if he knew that the two had terminated their engagement.What he fears most is the old man, so he is also the most reluctant to break off the engagement between Shi Sheng and Nangong Jing.

​​Whether it is from the interests of the two families or from a personal perspective, terminating the engagement is not a wise move.

"If it weren't for that brat... he would dare to eat secretly in his own home. He is really young and energetic, and he needs to be taught a lesson.

"Mr. Nangong."

Chu Tang suddenly made a sound, which frightened Nangong Zheng. He quickly turned around and looked at Chu Tang respectfully.

Chu Tang’s lips curved, “The girl has made it very clear, Mr. Nangong should not delay other people’s happiness.”

Nangong Zheng glanced at Shi Sheng with her head lowered. She could actually ask Chu Tang to help speak...

"I know." Chu Tang can bankrupt you with just one disagreement, and he doesn't dare to offend you.

Except for Shi Sheng and Nangong Zheng, no one present probably knew Chu Tang’s true identity, so Nangong Zheng looked so humble at this time, which really made people wonder about this young man’s identity.

But no one dared to ask.

The dissolution of the engagement required a press conference, so Nangong Zheng temporarily postponed the matter to three days later.

Three days is enough if anything happens.

Before leaving, Chu Tang gave Shi Sheng a business card. It had a black background and silver dark patterns. It was low-key and luxurious, but extremely noble.

There is only the word Chu Tang and a string of numbers on it, which is obviously a private number.
